description: Paginate ONE search query asynchronously and merge deduplicated organic results. Page-one AI Overview/PAA/Knowledge Graph/answer enrichments are retained; set render:true to request those Google JS blocks. Every page of the query from one device, queries rotate (mobile: iPhone or Android); search_bulk_status leads with search_parameters and search_metadata (served_*). Set `location` to compare SERPs. Billed per page actually fetched, with unavailable pages refunded.

browser.description: chrome (Windows/macOS, Android) | safari (macOS, iPhone) | firefox (desktop only). Omit to rotate. A device without that browser (e.g. android with safari) is refused.

device.description: desktop (default) | mobile = iPhone Safari or Android Chrome, one per query: every page from it, the next query may get the other | ios = iPhone Safari | android = Android Chrome

location.description: Search from this place, e.g. 'Milan, Italy'. Set it when comparing SERPs: Google ranks by city.

max_pages.description: Max pages to fetch (1-10, default 5). Stops early when Google has no more pages.

render.description: Force rendering to capture page-one Google JS enrichments

uule.description: Encoded geo token or raw coordinates

wait_for.description: Rendered path CSS selector for late panels

webhook.description: Public URL to POST the finished job to

name: search_bulk
